exposure: Nationality (Turkish women vs. Syrian refugee women)
outcome: Rate of delivery prior to 37 weeks of gestation
cohort: The study included 7950 pregnant Turkish women and 620 pregnant Syrian refugee women who gave birth at a hospital in Kocaeli, Turkey between January 2016 and July 2017.
finding: Syrian refugee women exhibited a higher rate of adolescent birth and low-birth-weight neonates compared to Turkish women.
mod_finding: The rate of normal delivery was significantly lower for Turkish women (51.6%) compared to Syrian refugee women (61.3%).
cross-section timing: Data was examined from records between January 1, 2016, and July 31, 2017.
birth_weight: A significant difference was found between the birth weights of infants, with Syrian refugees having a higher rate of low-birth-weight neonates.
gest_age: The rate of delivery prior to 37 weeks of gestation was higher for Syrian refugee women (3.2%) compared to Turkish women (1.8%).
